ranking.why: E20에서 27.2%로 가장 심각한 수치를 보이며, 식각 및 증착 시간 변화에 따른 변동성이 매우 큼
D3(3.23) 및 E60(2.51)에서 심각한 수준을 보이며, 공정 조건에 따라 프로파일이 민감하게 변함
E20 조건에서 10.0%의 높은 편차와 함께 좁아짐(narrowing) 현상이 발생함

aggregate.primary_issue: Profile shape control (Bowing, Taper) and CD dimension stability
tradeoffs: 증착 단계 시간을 늘리면 D7까지 bowing과 taper가 개선되나, D7을 초과(D9)하면 다시 taper가 악화됨.
식각 단계 시간이 짧으면(E20) bowing과 CD deviation(좁아짐)이 심해지고, 식각 단계 시간이 길어지면(E60) taper가 심해짐.

hypotheses.issue: Bowing and CD deviation (narrowing) at low etch step time (E20)
hypotheses.mechanism: Insufficient passivation layer formation due to short etch step time relative to deposition, leading to increased ion bombardment or spontaneous etching of the sidewall.
hypotheses.predicted_trend: As etch step time decreases, the protective layer becomes thinner or less stable, causing the profile to bow outward and the top CD to narrow due to lack of protection.
hypotheses.observed_trend: At E20 (etch 20s), bowing increased significantly to 27.2% and CD deviation (narrowing) worsened to 10.0% compared to D7.

hypotheses.issue: Tapering at high etch step time (E60) or low deposition step time (D3)
hypotheses.mechanism: Excessive etching or insufficient deposition of the protective layer, causing the profile to become more tapered (narrower at the bottom).
hypotheses.predicted_trend: As etch step time increases, the etching component dominates over the deposition component, leading to a more tapered profile.
hypotheses.observed_trend: Taper ratio was worst at D3 (3.23) and worsened again at E60 (2.51) compared to the optimal D7 (1.28).

hypotheses.issue: Bowing improvement with increased deposition time (D3 to D7)
hypotheses.mechanism: Increased deposition time provides a thicker and more robust passivation layer on the sidewalls, effectively suppressing bowing.
hypotheses.predicted_trend: Increasing the deposition step time should decrease the bowing index by providing better sidewall protection.
hypotheses.observed_trend: Bowing index improved from 19.8% (D3) to 0.5% (D7) as deposition time increased from 3s to 7s.

cannot_assess: 장비 이력 및 챔버 상태는 제공된 데이터로 확인 불가합니다.
undercut, sidewall_angle, mask_erosion, depth_loss는 데이터 부재로 인해 판정 불가합니다.
D9 조건의 bowing 및 taper는 데이터 부재로 인해 판정 불가합니다.

recommendation.expected_effect: To find the precise balance that maintains the low bowing (0.5%) achieved at D7 while preventing the taper degradation observed when increasing deposition time (D9).
recommendation.risk: Increasing deposition time beyond the optimal point may lead to a more tapered profile (as seen in the D9 trend).

alternatives.why: To identify the exact etch time that prevents bowing and CD narrowing (E20) without inducing excessive tapering (E60).
